question.text: According to the BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey 2022, what is the approximate average daily turnover of OTC foreign exchange markets globally?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 19 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) reports that, per the BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey 2022, the average daily turnover of OTC foreign exchange markets is approximately USD 7.5 trillion, with FX swaps as the largest instrument, followed by spot and outright forwards, plus options/other instruments and exchange-traded derivatives. The Trap: The other figures (USD 5.0 trillion, USD 10 trillion, USD 3.5 trillion) do not match the 2022 survey number cited on page 19. Note: The earlier comparison to an approximately USD 5 trillion 2016 survey figure was not found in the pages checked (15, 18, 19) and is not used here.
